messages.text:
No—your cancelled card does not stop the refund. It must still go to the original payment; your card issuer handles the credit, and the shop cannot promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Your rug refund proposal is **BRL 55.00** (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a chat message does not confirm it. A staff member must then approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
